name: Sbu PDF

replaces.name: GoodReader PDF Editor & Viewer
replaces.price_model: paid upfront plus Pro Pack auto-renewing subscription

one_thing: Sbu PDF fixes a PDF you already have (pages, crop, notes, form fields) and saves it back to the same file.

boundary_with_sbu_docs.sbu_docs: Makes a PDF from paper: camera capture (VisionKit document camera), cropping and filters at capture, OCR text layer, its own archive folder of PDFs (ADR-0006).
boundary_with_sbu_docs.sbu_pdf: Starts from an existing PDF picked in Files (any provider, Sbu Docs' folder included): reads, reorders, rotates, deletes, merges, splits, crops pages, annotates, fills forms, writes back in place. No camera, no OCR, no archive, no images-to-PDF.
boundary_with_sbu_docs.rule: If a feature creates a PDF from something that is not a PDF (camera, photos, paper) it belongs to Sbu Docs; if it changes a PDF that exists, it belongs to Sbu PDF. Sbu Docs keeps only page operations on its own fresh scan (delete or reorder before saving); after save it opens the file in Sbu PDF via the share sheet, never duplicates the editor.
boundary_with_sbu_docs.review_note: How it differs from the other Sbu apps: Sbu Docs turns paper into a PDF, Sbu PDF edits a PDF you already have. Neither can do the other's job.

features.name: Open from Files
features.description: fileImporter / document browser for PDFs from any File Provider (iCloud Drive, On My iPhone, Sbu Docs folder, third-party providers already installed). Opened in place with security-scoped access, never copied into the app.
features.reason: Entry point of every task; GoodReader's import-into-app model is what traps files.

features.name: Read
features.description: PDFKit view with continuous scroll, double-tap zoom, page thumbnails, search with result list, outline (table of contents) as a list, bookmarks stored in the PDF outline.
features.reason: GoodReader's base reading experience, used by every paying user.

features.name: Page tools
features.description: Reorder by drag in a thumbnail grid, rotate, delete (confirmed, undoable), duplicate, extract selection to a new PDF, insert pages from another PDF.
features.reason: Rotate and delete pages are behind the Pro Pack: named in 3 reviews as the reason they felt scammed.

features.name: Merge and split
features.description: Merge several PDFs in a chosen order into a new file; split at a page or every N pages.
features.reason: Merging is Pro Pack only (review us 27).

features.name: Real crop
features.description: Crop margins per page or for all pages; writes the crop box so the exported file is actually cropped.
features.reason: GoodReader's crop only affects reading, applies to all pages: 2 reviews.

features.name: Annotate
features.description: Highlight, underline, strike from text selection; ink with finger or Pencil; text box with system fonts and size; sticky note; undo/redo. Stored as standard PDF annotations readable by any viewer.
features.reason: GoodReader's star feature beyond reading; annotations must survive other apps (review us 11).

features.name: Save in place
features.description: Every change saved back to the original file through file coordination; 'Salva una copia' for a new file. No proprietary sidecar, no import copy.
features.reason: Files lost, corrupted or stranded after updates or device changes: 11 reviews; files trapped in the app: 5.

features.name: Share, print, open in
features.description: ShareLink and print (UIPrintInteractionController) on every document; drag out on iPad.
features.reason: Cannot email, print or send to WhatsApp: 5 reviews.

features.name: Folders from Files
features.description: Open a whole folder (iCloud Drive or local) with a security-scoped bookmark and list its PDFs; recents list. Not a file manager.
features.reason: Cannot open iCloud folders, only single files: 4 reviews.

features.name: Fill forms
features.description: AcroForm text fields, checkboxes, choices filled with PDFKit widgets and saved.
features.reason: Forms not shown or not fillable: 2 reviews.

features.name: Simple, native interface
features.description: List, NavigationStack, sheets; every tool reachable in two taps; no manual needed.
features.reason: Complex or dated UI, unusable help: 7 reviews.

features.name: Italian and English
features.description: Full string catalog in both languages.

features.name: Translate selection
features.description: Selected text offers the system translation sheet (.translationPresentation, iOS 17.4+); on 17.0-17.3 the system edit menu's Translate item is the fallback.
features.reason: Translate directly on the file: 2 reviews.

features.name: Two places in one document
features.description: Split view of the same PDF (top and bottom) to read text and its notes or figures together; switch between recent files.
features.reason: One document at a time, tabs and split view: 3 reviews.

features.name: Pencil draws, finger scrolls
features.description: When a Pencil is used, ink responds only to Pencil and fingers keep scrolling (PencilKit drawing policy).
features.reason: Must toggle annotate/browse mode every time: 1 review.

features.name: Faithful rendering
features.description: PDFKit rendering only, no custom reflow; images and white-on-black pages shown as the file defines them.
features.reason: PDFs with missing images or text, white type on black not shown: 3 reviews.

features.name: Signature
features.description: Draw a signature once, stored on device with complete file protection, place it as an ink annotation.
features.reason: Common need for a PDF fixer; not mentioned in reviews.

features.name: Password
features.description: Open password-protected PDFs; add or remove a password on save (PDFKit write options, AES-256).
features.reason: GoodReader sells AES-256 security in the Pro Pack; this is the file-level equivalent.

data_model.storage: No database (same principle as ADR-0006): the PDF files are the truth and stay where the user keeps them. Recents are a small Codable JSON of security-scoped bookmarks in Application Support. Edits are applied to PDFDocument in memory and written back with NSFileCoordinator (or UIDocument), atomically; nothing in iCloud beyond the user's own iCloud Drive files.

monetization.model: Paid upfront plus Pro Pack auto-renewing subscription (also offered as one-time purchase)
monetization.price: $6.99 US / 7.99 EUR IT upfront; Pro Pack per reviews about $17 per year or $79 one-time, 20 EUR per year
paywalled_features: page rotate, delete and merge (per reviews)
monetization.notes: Long-time buyers resent features moved into a subscription after paying (21 of 97 low-star reviews). Ads for the subscription shown to paying users (2).

review_risks.risk: Sbu Docs (archive of PDF files, ADR-0006) and Sbu PDF both centre on PDF from the same developer, after the 14/10 lot rejection; Apple asks why it is not a feature of another app.
review_risks.mitigation: Hard boundary (boundary_with_sbu_docs): Docs creates from paper, PDF edits existing files; no camera, OCR or images-to-PDF in Sbu PDF, no editor in Docs beyond pre-save page order. Answer 'why not a feature of Sbu Docs' explicitly in the review notes; submit them weeks apart; distinct screenshots.

review_risks.risk: A PDF tool easily mimics Preview's page sidebar, Files' browser or the Markup toolbar.
review_risks.mitigation: No file browser (system picker only), annotation bar built from SbuKit controls and SF Symbols in the app's accent, no Markup icons or layout; PKToolPicker not used.

review_risks.risk: PDF editors are a crowded Productivity niche.
review_risks.mitigation: Meaningful difference stated in notes: free page tools, real crop, in-place editing, no subscription; no 'PDF editor' keyword stuffing.

review_risks.risk: Low: GoodReader's look is not copied.
review_risks.mitigation: Native SwiftUI design system; GoodReader never named in metadata.
Review note on authorship and shared code, as in the Resolution Center answers.
Files only through the system picker, no background access, Data Not Collected; review note explains open-in-place.
